headline: Embraer Shares Fall After US Threatens Tariffs on Brazilian Aircraft
summary: Embraer shares suffered their largest drop since May after Washington raised the prospect of tariffs on Brazilian aircraft to exert pressure in trade negotiations.
why: Proposed industry-specific tariffs directly impact export competitiveness and share valuations for major multinational aerospace manufacturers.

impacts.name: Embraer
impacts.why: Proposed US tariffs on Brazilian aircraft create export uncertainties that depress the company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The threat of US tariffs on Brazilian aircraft raised concerns over export margins and trade friction, triggering a sharp selloff in Embraer stock.
